svg.title: Doc Pup - Request Ownership, Processing and Cancellation

g.text: Doc Pup - Request Ownership, Processing and Cancellation
Cancellation is an interrupting concurrent request, not a step after success.
See interaction 13 for the separate cancellation scenario.
JOBS and locks are process-local; no persistent queue or task table exists.
Form fill does not save Record. User reviews and submits separately.
File extraction: policy size limit (default 20 MB); text <=60000 chars;
PDF <=100 pages, no encryption or image-only input; audio <=600 seconds
for file mode; DOCX expanded size <=40 MB. No OCR path is implemented.
